ingredients: 1 little plastic thing (the technical term) of tomato paste
1 container of fresh mozzarella, thinly sliced
1 and a half packets of gf lasagne sheets
method: Go follow the bolognese recipe for the sauce!
Place spoonfuls of the bolognese sauce into a large oven dish to lightly fill the bottom
Sprinkle cheddar, mozzarella, parmesan onto the bolognese (not too much)
Add lasagne sheets on top so that everything is covered by a layer of sheets
Once the dish is nearly full, finish with a layer of bolognese sauce, and a good layer of cheese, with lots of fresh mozzarella
